# volcano_project_variable (Resource)

A project environment variable, propagated to functions and (when shared) to frontends.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcano_project_variable" "api_key" {
  project_id = volcano_project.example.id
  name       = "THIRD_PARTY_API_KEY"
  value      = var.third_party_api_key
  shared     = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Must start with a letter or underscore; letters, numbers, and underscores only. Forces replacement if changed.
- `project_id` (String)
- `value` (String, Sensitive)

### Optional

- `shared` (Boolean) Whether this variable is included in the project's shared frontend-variable list.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String) Latest propagation status (`provisioning`, `active`, or `failed`).
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import volcano_project_variable.api_key <project-id>,<name>
```
